items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: Then I used to even, when I worked first in Boston with Dean Earl

ctx.x: Then I used to even, when I worked first in Boston with Dean Earl, the basic notes I somehow just happened to go along with the pattern, you know what I mean. I could hear bass real good, especially would get together with the pianist and find out how he does his bass, which helped quite a bit, and passing tones and the proper bass to be fed to the different choruses that we played.
